* Electrical failure due to faulty wiring or electrical components

* Fuel starvation due to clogged fuel filter or malfunctioning fuel pump

* Overheating due to malfunctioning cooling system components or low coolant level
* Leakage due to damaged or corroded cooling system components or connections
* Failure to circulate coolant due to malfunctioning cooling system pump

* Failure to exhaust due to clogged or damaged exhaust system components
* Leakage due to damaged or corroded exhaust system components or connections
